To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the hybrid model combining preference ranking with TKs and point-wise ranking with CNNs outperforms the state of the arts in answer sentence rerankings and comment selection in Community Questions Answering and (ii) the proposed model is able to exploit both the syntactical information of the question-answer pairs and the embeddings learned from CNNs.

(1) the proposed ranking kernel for structures is a promising alternative to the state of the-art TKs for the task of answer sentence selection; (2) the proposed ranking model based on the combination of the proposed kernel for structures and embeddings for points is able to outperform the state of the- art in both answer sentence and comment selection.

(1) our approach is the first one to combine TKs and embeddings learned by CNN for the task of ranking, (2) we propose an effective hybrid approach that combines the best of two worlds, (3) we show that our approach obtains state of the art results on two different tasks, (4) our approach outperforms the best baselines on two different datasets.
